versions.subject: Merge PR #4939 from @frack113 - Winscp rule from Akira Ransomware report
versions.detection:
selection:
    - Image|endswith: '\WinSCP.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'winscp.exe'
filter_main_location:
    Image|startswith: 'C:\Program Files (x86)\WinSCP\'
condition: selection and not 1 of filter_main_*
versions.spl: Image="*\\WinSCP.exe" OR OriginalFileName="winscp.exe" NOT Image="C:\\Program Files (x86)\\WinSCP\\*"
